quarterly_data.quarter: Denka results briefing script: Q1 Financial Results Briefing for the Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (year ending March 2027): revenue JPY97 billion, operating income JPY11 billion, ordinary income JPY9.5 billion, net income JPY2.8 billion. CFO: operating income rose significantly on growing demand in AI-related sectors and for power infrastructure, the DPE suspension (+JPY3 billion) and inventory-related effects (+JPY6 billion, described as temporary).
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue JPY97 billion; operating income JPY11 billion (+JPY8.7 billion YoY)

quarterly_data.quarter: Denka results briefing script: Q1 Financial Results Briefing for the Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO on Electronics & Innovative Products: with xEV demand sluggish in Europe and North America, sales volumes for spherical alumina, acetylene black, silicon nitride and ceramic substrates were flat YoY; pricing increases for ceramic substrates proceeded as planned, resulting in a YoY increase. Demand kept expanding for spherical fused silica (resin substrates, optical ferrules) and spherical alumina (thermal conductive molding compound); acetylene black sales for data center and ESS grew rapidly.

quarterly_data.quarter: Denka results briefing script: Q1 Financial Results Briefing for the Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO on AI materials: Denka sells SNECTON (soft resin) and spherical silica (filler) for low-loss rigid CCLs used in AI / high-speed communications. The dedicated plant for soft-type SNECTON was completed in May; samples have shipped from the new plant and customer certification is proceeding smoothly; establishing the latest grade as the de facto standard for M9-equivalent CCL is progressing and evaluation of the next-generation M10-equivalent CCL is favorable. SNECTON AI-related sales are expected to take off in earnest from H2; for hard-type SNECTON the company is in the final stages of considering further facility expansion.

quarterly_data.quarter: Denka results briefing script: Q1 Financial Results Briefing for the Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 forecast revised upward; Electronics & Innovative Products H1 forecast raised by JPY2 billion to JPY6 billion as AI demand exceeds initial projections, and the segment is expected to beat its full-year plan. The company-wide full-year forecast is not revised now (Middle East / raw-material uncertainty) and will be revisited at Q2 results. FY2026 investment projected at JPY47 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: E&IP H1 forecast JPY6 billion (+JPY2 billion); FY2026 investment JPY47 billion
